name: 280. OpenAI passthrough Responses stream ends on response.completed (PR #9177) (passthrough responses end event)
description: Codex CLI and Codex Desktop close the connection as soon as they read response.completed. The OpenAI passthrough stream used to finish only on upstream EOF, so a client that hung up first was logged as cancelled (499, 'Request cancelled: client disconnected') with no usage. core/providers/utils/passthrough_stream.go now finishes the stream on a provider end event (PassthroughStreamParams.EndsStream; OpenAI matches response.completed, response.failed, response.incomplete and error) and abandons the upstream body instead of draining it. newman reads the stream to EOF, so it cannot reproduce the early hangup; that is pinned by TestStreamPassthrough_EndsStreamFinalizesBeforeClientHangup and TestStreamPassthrough_EndsStreamAbandonsParkedUpstream. This case pins the wire path: a streamed Responses request through /openai_passthrough completes, and its log row ends as success with the usage from response.completed.

item.name: openai/gpt-4o-mini /openai_passthrough/v1/responses streaming ends on response.completed - PR #9177

exec: pm.test('openai responses end event: stream returned 200', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(200); });
pm.test('openai responses end event: stream carried response.completed', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('response.completed'); });
pm.test('openai responses end event: x-bifrost-request-id echoed', function () { pm.expect(reqId, 'x-bifrost-request-id header').to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.get('baseUrl') + '/api/logs/' + reqId, method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) {
pm.test('openai responses end event: log row is success, not cancelled', function () { pm.expect(j.status, JSON.stringify(j)).to.eql('success'); });

pm.test('openai responses end event: log row is a passthrough stream', function () { pm.expect(j.is_passthrough, JSON.stringify(j)).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.stream, JSON.stringify(j)).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('openai responses end event: usage from response.completed recorded', function () { pm.expect(j.token_usage, JSON.stringify(j)).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(j.token_usage.total_tokens, JSON.stringify(j.token_usage)).to.be.above(0); });

pm.test('openai responses end event: log row finalized', function () { pm.expect.fail('log ' + reqId + ' still processing or missing after 10 reads: ' + (err ? String(err) : (res.code + ' ' + res.text()))); });
